name: Claude Code
description: Install Claude Code CLI into any devcontainer. Supports Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine, Arch, Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, and Amazon Linux on amd64/arm64.

version.description: Claude Code version to install (semver or 'latest'). Recommend pinning for teams.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version to install if not already present (>= 18 required).

installPath.description: Custom npm global install prefix. Feature ensures <installPath>/bin is on PATH.

enableMcpServers.description: Create a starter MCP server configuration at ~/.claude/mcp_servers.json (create-if-absent).

mountHostConfig.description: Log a mounts snippet for host ~/.claude config passthrough (documentation-only, does NOT auto-mount).

shellCompletions.description: Install shell completions for bash, zsh, and fish.
